recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The current core source already implements the Published Jira decision; no follow-up is needed unless a future tracker requests a broader editorial rewrite of Reference.type.
issue_request: FHIR-39290 asked to remove the Reference.type comment sentence stating that if both type and reference are present, the reference SHALL resolve to a resource of the same type. The issue was Published/Persuasive for R5 because that wording was redundant with the definition's consistency SHALL and incorrectly implied that Reference.reference must resolve when type is present.
initial_application: Git commit f33b8b9e0b27fe06995acde5a15329725904b3eb, "FHIR-39290 Remove extraneous comment from Reference.type," already removed the exact disputed sentence from source/datatypes/reference.xml. The combined branch contains that source commit, and no earlier Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-39290 commit was found before this audit.
additional_context: Reference is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini and is rendered by source/references.html via the Reference datatype include, so source/datatypes/reference.xml is the relevant build-scoped source. Zulip discussion in #implementers identified the same overstatement and led to the tracker, and FHIR-I January 2023 minutes record the Persuasive 27-0-6 vote. Jira phrase searches found only FHIR-39290, so no opportunistic related issue was decided.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/datatypes/reference.xml retains the definition sentence that Reference.type and a FHIR Reference.reference SHALL be consistent, and the Reference.type comment no longer includes the erroneous SHALL-resolve sentence.
